class.name: GameplayController
class.brief_description: A non-physical gameplay agent that possesses pawns and owns persistent player state.
class.description: GameplayController separates input or decision ownership from the replaceable [GameplayPawn]. It maintains one-to-one, bidirectional links to its pawn and [GameplayPlayerState]. The gameplay peer ID is not network authority and must not be used to transfer authoritative simulation away from a dedicated server.

method.name: get_game_mode
method.description: Returns the authoritative game mode that admitted this controller, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_pawn
method.description: Returns whether this controller currently possesses a live pawn.

method.name: possess
method.description: Possesses [param pawn]. Existing relationships on both sides are detached first. Returns [constant OK] on success.

method.name: unpossess
method.description: Releases the current pawn while retaining the player state.

members.member: The gameplay owner peer identity. Changing it also updates the possessed pawn.
Persistent player identity and match state associated with this controller.

signal.name: player_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the player-state relationship changes.
